experiment: Native AdamW paired augmented/unaugmented Fashion-MNIST120epochs; every-epoch records
schedule: Identical in both conditions:5-epoch warmup to0.001; cosine to0.0001 at fixedepoch120. Same number of steps and learning-rate history.

native_adamw.explicit_decay: Same prior native baseline: all parameters multiplied by (1-1e-5*factor)^(actual_batch_size/256); torch AdamW weight_decay=0 to avoid double decay. At full B256 equals WD .01 decoupled AdamW.

augmentation.on: training-only zero-padded translations up to2pixels, independent per-example coin p=.5, SeedSequence([seed,epoch,batch_index,991]); same historical implementation

pairing: Identical initial model, ordered minibatch indices and schedule within each seed. Augmentation is the only condition difference. Validation/test images never augmented.
data: Original55000/5000/10000 split and pixels/255; historical test set already seen.
primary: Compare per-layer alpha, |alpha-2|, sub2 deficit, accuracy and CE across the complete0–120epoch trajectories; fixed primary endpoint120 and paired augmented-minus-unaugmented contrasts.
secondary: Prespecified20→60→120 within-trajectory changes; FC3 exploratory; ECE15/Brier, all layer norms/tail support, fixed-rank alpha20%/50%, exact step/cumulative LR/decay accounting.
test_access: Evaluate EVERY saved epoch0–120 only AFTER that trajectory completes120; no test feedback to training. No selection. Validation and raw spectra everyepoch.
selection: No early stopping, alpha target, best-validation selection, tuning, or automatic extension. Scientific nulls and functional failures retained.
uncertainty: Only2independent paired seeds. Show both individuals, mean/range and paired changes; no confirmatory significance claim, no epoch/layer-as-replicate intervals.
spectral_support: Default hidden-layer WeightWatcher fits with raw spectra, xmin/tail count/KS and >=50evals,>=20tail,KS<=.2 sensitivity; no alpha-targeted cutoff. FC3 has only10correlated eigenvalues, native and direct smallN estimates exploratory.
late_training_interpretation: This is a120epoch paired diagnostic, not a very-long-horizon convergence test. No claim that optimizer bias disappears asymptotically; alpha>=2 differs from alpha close to2.
queue: Shared GitHub concurrency group serializes this experiment after the active continuation; no changes to prior workflow.

fc3_estimator.method: WWFit.fit_powerlaw_smallN called directly; J selection preserved
fc3_estimator.uncertainty: 10 correlated eigenvalues; correction is not proof of accurate tail exponent

logging: Every epoch: full train/validation CE+accuracy, spectra and alpha, model+optimizer+RNG checkpoint; every minibatch: loss, gradient/moment/update norms and directions; test/calibration every saved epoch evaluated after all training updates.
